# BREADKUN Unified Authentication

Integrated Authentication (SSO) service for the BREADKUN ecosystem and partner projects.

## Core Features
- **One Account, Every Access**: Sign in once and use all connected services without additional registration.
- **Dynamic Branding**: Real-time UI theme and logo synchronization based on the client application.
- **High Security**: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect based secure authentication flows.
- **Premium UI**: Cinematic glassmorphism design with optimized user experience.

## Key Links
- [Main Landing Page](https://auth.breadkun.com/)
- [Login Service](https://auth.breadkun.com/login)
- [Member Registration](https://auth.breadkun.com/join)
- [Account Connections](https://auth.breadkun.com/settings/connections)

## Technical Stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Framer Motion
- Tailwind CSS 4
- OpenID Connect / JWT
